_comment: The parts of bemu's binaries Cargo does not know of, for tools/licenses.py (which writes third_party/licenses.json).

components.name: Amstrad CPC firmware, BASIC and AMSDOS ROMs
components.text: The CPC's firmware, BASIC and AMSDOS are copyright Amstrad plc and Locomotive Software. Amstrad has allowed their distribution with emulators, provided they are not charged for and Amstrad's copyright notices are kept: bemu's binaries must therefore be given away, not sold. They remain Amstrad's property.
components.note: os464, os664, os6128 (and French), basic464, basic664, basic6128 (and French), amsdos

components.name: Amstrad DMP2000 printer EPROM
components.text: Copyright Amstrad plc. Distributed with the emulator under the same understanding as the CPC's ROMs: not charged for, Amstrad's copyright kept.
components.note: The DMP2000's characters (Spanish version, dumped by the CPC community, CPCWiki)

components.name: M4 board ROM v2.0.8
components.text: Copyright Duke (M4Duke). Its source is published at https://github.com/M4Duke/m4rom; it remains its author's property and is distributed with bemu to emulate the M4 board. Its author can ask for its removal.

components.name: RulezCharge 0.9b2 for the M4
components.text: Copyright CPCrulez. Its licence is not stated: it is distributed with bemu, unmodified, so that RulezCharge can be used with the emulated M4. Its authors can ask for its removal.

components.name: UniDOS 1.51, its nodes and UniTools
components.text: Copyright Futurs'. Distributed with bemu, unmodified, as a free download from its authors; it remains their property under their terms. Its authors can ask for its removal.

components.name: Orgams ROMs
components.text: Copyright the Orgams authors. Distributed with bemu, unmodified, as a free download from its authors; it remains their property under their terms. Its authors can ask for its removal.

components.name: HxC Floppy Emulator library (libhxcfe, libhxcadaptor)
components.note: Reads and writes HFE images. Because it is GPL-3.0, bemu's binaries are distributed under the GPL-3.0.
